verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.ultrametric.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an index linking to markdown doc pages, and the docs are served as agent-readable .md files. The CLI also writes agent skill files for Codex and Claude Code, a dry-run probe confirmed both targets, so agents get agent-oriented instructions as well as the index. missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt content's depth or completeness (e.g., an llms-full.txt or full page coverage) and independent third-party corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: The CLI can add Ultrametric instructions to a project for Codex and Claude Code.
the dry run previews both harness targets (Codex .agents/skills and Claude Code .claude/skills) without writing anything
